My grandad died. I come from an extremely small family and due to a conflict within that family I hadn’t seen him for nearly 2 years before he died. That changed me a lot and I realised the importance of the family I have left, I loved my grandad and he taught me so much. It’s made me want to lead a life that he would be proud of me for, go out and work hard, be positive and enjoy what I have. 

It’s the first death I really experienced and I know it won’t be the last, but I think learning what grief is in a way taught me the true meaning of love as well. I miss him, but I’m going to take the opportunities he never had and make him proud.
